subject: Discovery recap & quick check on priority and cost sensitivity
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>
To: Alex Flores <alex@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.example>
Date: 2028-02-15T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + short pilot suggestion

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our call and a suggested next step so we can both evaluate fit without a big lift on your side:

Key notes from discovery:
- Current pain: latency spikes during morning batch windows causing degraded UX for customer-facing flows.
- Volume: ~30k inference requests/day, peak bursts ~3–5k/min.
- Data constraints: PII filtering required, retention window 30 days, SOC2 compliance important.
- Goal: reduce 95th percentile latency to <250ms while keeping unit cost within acceptable bounds for a pilot.

Suggested next step: short 4-week pilot using Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) with automatic prefix caching and KV cache warmup. We can scope a narrow QA route and sample production traffic to measure latency/cost under realistic bursts.

I attached a 1-page discovery notes summary and a 1-tab pilot proposal (timeline + minimal data/infra asks). If that sounds reasonable, can we lock a 15-min alignment call next week (I’m flexible Tue/Wed morning PT)?

If the priority has shifted or this should go to someone else on your team, please let me know — happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.example | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: 20280215-discovery-notes.pdf, pilot-proposal-short.xlsx
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>
To: Alex Flores <alex@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.example>
Date: 2028-02-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow — fit & timing check

Hi Alex —

Following up on the note I sent last week (below) — wanted to check whether this pilot still aligns with StellarPay’s priorities for the next quarter.

Short options if helpful:
- 15-min sync to confirm scope and timeline (I can send a calendar invite)
- I can send a one-pager with expected unit pricing ranges and typical P95 latencies for similar workloads
- Or, if now isn’t the right time, tell me the best quarter to revisit and I’ll pause outreach until then.

No pressure — just trying to be respectful of your bandwidth.

Best,
Olga

From: Alex Flores <alex@stellarpay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>
Date: 2028-02-20T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow — fit & timing check

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the follow. Short version: this is interesting but not a priority for StellarPay in Q2 — we’re committed to a roadmap focused on core payments features and compliance work.

Two asks while we hold this:
1) Can you send a one-page that shows expected unit pricing ranges for a 30k req/day profile and the typical 95th percentile latency we see in similar pilots? High-level numbers are fine — we just need budget guidance to assess whether this is worth prioritizing later.
2) Also include any minimum data-handling or SOC2 evidence we should pass to security if we revisit (audit artifacts or SOC2 reference doc).

If those two items look okay we’ll reassess for a potential Q3 pilot.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Flores | Head of Platform
StellarPay
alex@stellarpay.com | +1 617-555-0248
